question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.
sql:
-- Check ties for match 392207
WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, striker, non_striker,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as rn
    FROM ball_by_ball
),
with_pair AS (
    SELECT *,
           LEAST(striker, non_striker) as bat1,
           GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as bat2
    FROM ball_data
),
with_pair_change AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN (bat1 = LAG(bat1) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn) 
                   AND bat2 = LAG(bat2) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn))
                THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as pair_changed
    FROM with_pair
),
with_segment AS (
    SELECT *,
           SUM(pair_changed) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY rn) as segment_id
    FROM with_pair_change
),
segment_runs AS (
    SELECT ws.match_id, ws.innings_no, ws.segment_id,
           ws.bat1 as player1, ws.bat2 as player2,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ws.striker = ws.bat1 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) ELSE 0 END) as player1_score,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ws.striker = ws.bat2 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) ELSE 0 END) as player2_score,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM with_segment ws
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON ws.match_id = bs.match_id AND ws.over_id = bs.over_id AND ws.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND ws.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY ws.match_id, ws.innings_no, ws.segment_id, ws.bat1, ws.bat2
),
max_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM segment_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT sr.match_id, sr.player1, sr.player2, sr.player1_score, sr.player2_score, sr.partnership_runs
    FROM segment_runs sr
    JOIN max_partnership mp ON sr.match_id = mp.match_id AND sr.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
)
SELECT match_id, player1, player2, player1_score, player2_score, partnership_runs
FROM qualified
WHERE match_id = 392207
ORDER BY match_id, partnership_runs DESC
